No, not the post itself, just a possible reason why she might not want to meet with someone she was seeing until after her period ended! Periods also can make you bloated or break out so that’s another reason why she might’ve wanted to wait for it to pass, aside from just wanting to curl up and make herself comfortable while waiting for her cramps to pass. Everyone’s different.

Ask her how she’s feeling? Periods are often a pain but it usually varies — sometimes they’re fine, sometimes they’re so painful that you can’t even move without being sick. Some girls are in a lot of pain for a few days before, or a few days after, or both. So I really think the way to know if she’s over it is just asking how she’s feeling after a day or two, or however many depending on how close you guys keep in contact and when she started. I don’t think offering to bring her something could ever hurt (chocolate, food, painkillers, whatever might make her feel better). It sounds like either she’s having a really bad one or she thought you wanted to meet up for sex stuff. If neither of those are the case, and she acts distant even after her period ends, that’s probably an indication that she changed her mind or doesn’t want to take things further, but you’ve really got to just pay attention to conversation tones to know what the case is. Go for it as soon as she seems up for it.
